senses.gloss:
Astṛ, ‘shooter,’ is a term frequently used in the Rigveda and Atharvaveda for the archer who fought from the chariot.
Foot notes i. 8, 4; 64, 10; ii. 42, 2, etc.
vi. 93, 1. 2; xi. 2, 7. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 296.

Āstra-budhna is the name of a man whom indra is said in the Rigveda to have assisted. It is not clear whether Venya, who is mentioned in the same line, was his friend or his enemy, whom indra saved or defeated for him.
Foot notes x. 171, 3.
So Grassmann and Griffith in their translations.
So Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 167.
